title: One Second Away
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘One Second Away’, a luxury 7-bed, 7 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 22 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Gulf Views & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Second Floor Pool with Gulf Views (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1-May 1) -Gulf Views -Steps from Beach Access -Elevator -Six Seater Golf Cart Included -Six Bikes Included ‘One Second Away’ boasts sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico, complemented by stunning architecture. Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, this luxury vacation home offers the ultimate in convenience – hence the name - with beach access just steps away, you can be basking on the sand in moments. The home is equipped with a second-floor heated pool, multiple living spaces, and an impressive outdoor living area. It also features a private carriage house, an elevator, and ample guest parking, ensuring that every detail has been meticulously designed to suit your needs. Approximately one mile from Seaside, this ‘One Second Away’ provides unparalleled access to all the amenities of the 30A area, including pristine white sands, crystal-clear waters, world-class fishing spots, top-notch dining options, and luxury shopping. The layout is thoughtfully designed, offering seven bedrooms, seven full bathrooms, and two half bathrooms. The ground floor is home to three bedrooms, with the first featuring a spacious en-suite bathroom that can double as a second primary bedroom or a generous guest room. Down the hall, another bedroom and a large bunk room are available, complete with two built-in queen-size bunks and an additional twin bunk. These bedrooms are connected to an additional living space and a first-floor patio. The home offers a convenient elevator allowing easy access to all three floors. The second floor is where you'll find the extraordinary great room that overlooks the 30A area and the Gulf of Mexico. This open floor plan seamlessly connects the living room, dining room, and gourmet kitchen. The chef's kitchen is equipped with a 48" gas Wolf range, a 36" Sub-Zero refrigerator, a 36" Sub-Zero freezer, two Asko Dishwashers, and a large kitchen island, complete with a wet-bar featuring a beverage fridge and an ice machine. From the gas range to the beautiful fireplace, this room is designed to accommodate large gatherings and social events. The second floor is home to an additional king bedroom, a large entertaining room, an incredible porch, and more outstanding views of the Gulf. On the third floor you will find the primary bedroom. This relaxing retreat boasts a beautiful vaulted ceiling, Gulf views, access to the porch, a spacious en-suite bathroom, and an expansive walk-in closet. The space and finishes of this primary suite are designed for ultimate luxury. Off the primary bedroom, there's an additional living space featuring a wet-bar and porch access. An additional king bedroom, an office and a full bathroom are also available on this floor. North of the main house, is the carriage house which offers a cozy retreat for guests seeking a bit more privacy. This carriage house is equipped with a kitchenette, a private bedroom and a spacious bathroom. - Sleeping Arrangements - First Floor King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen Bunks + One Twin over Twin Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Second Floor Bedroom - King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower Third Floor Primary Bedroom - Primary Bathroom with Large Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Carriage House King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
